class.name: CrimsonServiceProvider
class.brief_description: Supplies custom services for one Crimson game scope.

method.name: _create_online_directory
method.description: Returns the optional online directory for this game scope. Configure an authenticator on the session as well to use authenticated online host and join operations.

method.name: _create_scene_loader
method.description: Returns a fresh detached scene loader. The game attaches and owns it. Omit the override to use the default loader.

method.name: _create_session
method.description: Returns a fresh detached session. The game attaches and owns it. Omit the override to use the default session.
